answer: Each agent posts a small refundable bond into a velvet-roped escrow that only unlocks after a spiral of linked, unpredictable micro-tasks: every completed job seeds the next challenge, so an identity's history forms one continuous chain, like verses building a sonnet. A clone cannot copy the chain without redoing every task, and quitting forfeits the bond. Creating a thousand fakes means funding a thousand bonds and a thousand unbroken chains; honest agents pay once, farms pay forever.
